# Record Club

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 9 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Signed-out music-community marketing and directory pages: GTFAdieu display headings over GT America body, a black primary pill that flips to white in dark, 8px buttons, 4px artwork, 16px bento blocks, and a light-dark custom-property layer (--bg, --fg, --color-brand, --color-text)..

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing, browse, releases, one public album page, help, about, supporter pricing, login and register were read and not submitted. Apple and Google were not pressed. Checkout was not opened.. Themes: light, dark.

Public signed-out surfaces of [record.club](https://record.club/), a social music network, captured on 2026-11-19. Readings came from a T3 preview tab at 1440×900 and 390×844, both at devicePixelRatio 2. The product's theme switch is `data-theme` on `<html>` (`light`, `dark`, or `system` plus `data-system-theme`). The attached session resolved `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, so system mode painted dark until `data-theme` was set to `light` in the page. No account setting was changed. Nothing was signed in, typed, or purchased.

Screenshots were not taken. `preview_snapshot` failed with "The browser is not producing screenshot frames." Headless Chromium received HTTP 403 and a Cloudflare interstitial, so it was not used.

## Typography

11 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: GT America, GTFAdieu.

### Fonts (from README.md)

GT America (400, 500, 600, 900, plus italics at 400 and 500) is the UI face. The file declared at weight 600 is named `GT-America-Standard-Bold.woff2`. GTFAdieu Bold (declared weight 700) is the display face on `.heading-main`. GT America Mono is declared and was not used on a measured element. All three are Grilli Type faces, served from `/assets/fonts/`. They are proprietary and are not in this package. The token stacks name them and fall back to the system faces the site itself lists after GT America.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Dark footer, bento and placeholder colours in [tokens.json](tokens.json) are copies of a measured neighbour so the light and dark sets share keys. Each of those tokens says Derived in `$extensions.source`. The browse explore card kept a dark border after `data-theme` was set to light, so that border is not the light card colour. Email and password fields on `/login` kept dark fills (`#484848`, `#333333`) after the same flip. The light field fill is the focused register field, `#f2f2f2`.

`--color-brand` has a losing stylesheet value of `#9b56ef`. The computed value, after the oklab query, is `light-dark(#6e36ff, #ab68ff)`. Tokens use the computed value. Shadow alphas live in `$extensions.alpha` because the DTCG colour is the opaque ink.

There are no screenshots. Do not treat the style guide as a picture of the product.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the black pill for the primary action in light, and the white pill in dark.** Home "Create free account" is `#121212` on `#fcfcfc` at 8px radius. The same class in dark is white on `#111111`.
- **Set display headings in GTFAdieu at 700 with a tight track.** About and help compute 44px, line 48.4px, tracking -0.44px, colour `#141414` in light.
- **Keep body copy in GT America at 15px / 22.5px.** The ink is `#2c2a25` in light and `#eeeeee` in dark.
- **Do not invent a screenshot.** This capture has computed styles and no frames. The preview browser did not produce screenshot frames, and headless Chromium hit Cloudflare.
